anchors: Requirement: A coupon is held by nothing, and the newest claim is the only live one
Requirement: A member runs their own membership from one surface
Requirement: A redemption settles as a coupon, whatever the reward
Requirement: A spent redemption stays spent when its artifact expires
Requirement: Every recorded mutation answers the same way when retried
Requirement: Reversing a redemption restores the points it consumed, while its coupon is unused
Requirement: A code carries its own coupon's combine setting
Requirement: A coupon reaches the order as its own ephemeral Shopify Discount code
Requirement: A live cart price previews locally, and mints nothing until an order claims the coupon
Requirement: A sale that loses its claim loses its code, and a paid sale is settled against what it carried
Requirement: The same discount-code mechanism applies online and at the POS till
